title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

  • Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

  • Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

  • Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days)

  • 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

  • 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

  • 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities

1. Storytelling That Converts

  • Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

  • Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

  • Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

  • Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution

  • Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

  • Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

  • Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA

  • Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

  • Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

  • Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

  • Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops

  • Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

  • Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

  • Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

  • Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

What We Are Looking For

Essential Experience & Qualifications

  • 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

  • Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

  • Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

  • Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

  • Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

  • CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

Mindset & Soft Skills

  • Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

  • Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

  • Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

Working Environment & Expectations

  • Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

  • Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win.

  • Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively.

Why join Papers?

  • Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means.

  • High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes.

  • Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

  • Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth.

  • 25 days paid vacation per year.

  • Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly).

  • Support for your ongoing learning and development.r

  • Entwicklung von Konzepten für Produktionsanlagen und Automatisierungslösungen, von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur Detailausarbeitung

  • Sichere und benutzerorientierte Auslegung der Anlagen (Usabilility / Safety / Ergonomie / Lifecycle cost)

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. You'll win deals by proving the business value of OpenSpace, get new customers live quickly, and drive the adoption that turns first projects into long-term, growing accounts. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region.

What you will be doing

  • Owning the technical win with the Account Executive, from discovery and tailored demos through to a signed contract
  • Scoping, running and closing out pilots and proofs of value, with clear success criteria agreed with the AE and the customer
  • Finding and qualifying expansion opportunities in existing accounts and building pipeline with the AE
  • Leading the value and ROI conversation at renewal and expansion, using usage data and customer outcomes to build business cases
  • Onboarding new customers: project setup, capture training for field teams and admin training for project managers
  • Driving adoption after go-live through usage reviews, project check-ins and value reviews with customer stakeholders
  • Answering technical, security and data privacy (GDPR) questions, supporting tenders and RFPs, and advising on integrations such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma)
  • Bringing market feedback to the Product team and building German-language enablement material with Marketing

What we are looking for

  • A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a construction technology or AEC software company, or in project or site management at an owner or construction company
  • A proven track record in pre-sales, solutions consulting or customer success with shared revenue targets
  • Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written
  • Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH
  • A solid understanding of how construction projects run, from preconstruction to handover, including site documentation and progress tracking
  • Experience with complex B2B sales cycles, value selling and qualification methods such as MEDDPICC
  • Familiarity with construction software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) and BIM tools
  • Reality capture or 360° imaging experience is a plus
  • Knowledge of the DACH construction market and its main contractors is a plus

How you like to work

  • Commercially minded: You spot expansion opportunities, build the ROI case and help the AE move deals forward. You can turn usage data into a clear story about customer value.
  • A clear communicator: You adapt your message to site managers, project managers and executives, and you explain technical concepts in plain language.
  • Organized and independent: You can run several onboardings and pilots at once, and you're comfortable in a small regional team that works closely with colleagues in other countries and time zones.

If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

title: Technisch Support Engineer
description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen.

Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken.

Waarom ontstaat een storing? Hoe kunnen we die in de toekomst voorkomen? En hoe kunnen we onze support slimmer organiseren?

Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams.

  • Je deelt inzichten uit de praktijk met onze product- en engineeringteams, zodat we onze warmtepompen verder kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je denkt mee over hoe we onze processen en systemen kunnen verbeteren en automatiseren.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die technisch nieuwsgierig is, graag problemen oplost en energie krijgt van het helpen van anderen. Je hoeft nog geen expert in warmtepompen te zijn. We leren je graag hoe onze systemen werken.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands.

  • Je bent zelfstandig, leergierig en neemt initiatief wanneer je ziet dat iets beter kan.

  • Ervaring met Python, data-analyse of het automatiseren van processen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij DeWarmte houden we van mensen die initiatief nemen, nieuwsgierig zijn en samen dingen beter willen maken. Je hoeft niet alles al te kunnen. Als je graag leert, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van techniek en het helpen van mensen, maken we graag kennis met je.

En daar krijg je alle ruimte voor.

Je ontwikkelt je eigen visie op de financiële organisatie, stelt een financiële roadmap op en bouwt een schaalbaar team. Je vertaalt cijfers naar betere beslissingen, daagt bestaande aannames uit en helpt ons de juiste keuzes te maken terwijl we groeien.

We zoeken iemand die strategisch denkt, maar ook graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt. Die het grotere plaatje ziet, maar net zo makkelijk de diepte ingaat om een financieel vraagstuk op te lossen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Financial Director ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor Finance én denk je als MT-lid mee over de koers van DeWarmte. Je bouwt voort op een sterke financiële basis en zorgt dat onze financiële organisatie klaar is voor de volgende groeifase.

Financiële strategie en business performance

  • Je ontwikkelt de financiële strategie en roadmap en vertaalt onze groeiambities naar concrete plannen en doelstellingen.

  • Je bent een strategische sparringpartner voor de founders en het MT. Je daagt aannames uit, beoordeelt kansen en helpt bij belangrijke investerings- en bedrijfsbeslissingen.

  • Je vertaalt financiële en operationele data naar inzichten die onze prestaties, winstgevendheid en besluitvorming verbeteren.

Financiële planning, control en financiering

  • Je neemt het eigenaarschap over ons geïntegreerde financiële model en bent verantwoordelijk voor budgettering, forecasting, scenarioanalyses en managementrapportages.

  • Je stuurt op cashflow, liquiditeit en werkkapitaal en zorgt dat we onze groei financieel kunnen blijven ondersteunen.

  • Je leidt de financiële voorbereiding van financieringsrondes en due diligence-trajecten en verzorgt de rapportages aan aandeelhouders.

  • Je waarborgt betrouwbare financiële administratie, rapportages en compliance, inclusief de verdere inrichting van onze Duitse activiteiten.

Bouwen aan een schaalbare finance-organisatie

  • Je ontwikkelt en leidt ons Finance-team, te beginnen met een Financial Controller, en stuurt onze externe financiële partners aan.

  • Je verbetert processen en systemen en benut automatisering en AI om Finance slimmer en efficiënter te organiseren.

  • Je zorgt voor heldere financiële verantwoordelijkheden en controles, zonder onnodige bureaucratie.

Je combineert dus strategie met uitvoering. De ene dag bespreek je met het MT de langetermijnstrategie, de andere dag duik je zelf in een forecast, werk je aan een financieringsvraagstuk of verbeter je een proces. Je voelt je comfortabel op beide niveaus.

Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken een Financial Director die financiële expertise combineert met ondernemerschap, leiderschap en een sterk gevoel voor de business.

Wat je meebrengt:

  • Ruime ervaring in senior financiële functies, bij voorkeur binnen een snelgroeiend bedrijf of een scale-up.

  • Een sterke achtergrond in zowel financial control als financial planning & analysis (FP&A).

  • Ervaring met het vertalen van bedrijfsstrategie naar financiële plannen en concrete resultaten.

  • Sterke financiële modelleervaardigheden en een goed begrip van P&L, balans, cashflow en de operationele factoren die deze beïnvloeden.

  • Ervaring in een hardware-, productie-, energie-, logistieke of andere werkkapitaalintensieve omgeving is een groot voordeel.

  • Ervaring met financiering, fundraising, kredietfaciliteiten of due diligence is een plus.

  • Het vermogen om een financiële functie en team op te bouwen, zonder zelf de aansluiting met de dagelijkse praktijk te verliezen.

  • Affiniteit met technologie, automatisering en AI.

  • Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Engels op professioneel niveau.

Minstens zo belangrijk vinden we hoe je werkt:

  • Je denkt als ondernemer. Je kijkt verder dan de cijfers en begrijpt hoe Finance bijdraagt aan het succes van het hele bedrijf.

  • Je hebt een eigen visie. Je brengt ideeën mee, daagt de status quo uit en durft de founders en andere MT-leden kritisch tegen te spreken.

  • Je bouwt voort op wat goed werkt. Je neemt de tijd om de business en bestaande processen te begrijpen, voordat je bepaalt wat beter kan.

  • Je neemt eigenaarschap. Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat er moet gebeuren, maar ziet kansen, stelt prioriteiten en komt in actie.

  • Je combineert strategie met executie. Je krijgt energie van richting bepalen, maar net zo goed van zelf dingen voor elkaar krijgen.

  • Je voelt je thuis in een scale-up. Je houdt van snelheid, kunt omgaan met verandering en onzekerheid en hebt geen volledig uitgewerkt plan nodig om vooruitgang te boeken.

Wat wij bieden

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €7.500 en €9.000 op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

  • Een sleutelrol binnen ons Management Team, met veel verantwoordelijkheid en directe invloed op de toekomst van DeWarmte.

  • De ruimte om je eigen visie te realiseren en een financiële organisatie op te bouwen die met ons meegroeit.

  • Deelname aan ons SAR-programma, waarmee je financieel meeprofiteert van de groei en het succes van DeWarmte.

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

  • Iedere dag een gezamenlijke lunch op kantoor.

  • Regelmatige teamuitjes en borrels, waaronder onze jaarlijkse stranddag en wintersport.

  • Een informele, ondernemende werkomgeving met korte lijnen, ambitieuze collega's en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Waarom DeWarmte?

Een echte plek aan tafel. Als vierde lid van ons Management Team heb je directe invloed op onze strategie, prioriteiten en toekomst.

De kans om iets op te bouwen. Er ligt een sterke financiële basis, maar jij krijgt de ruimte en verantwoordelijkheid om de financiële organisatie, het team en de roadmap voor de komende jaren vorm te geven.

Een bedrijf midden in een belangrijke groeifase. In een fase van groeiende activiteiten en internationale ambities stap je in op een moment waarop sterk financieel leiderschap echt het verschil kan maken.

Een ondernemende, hands-on cultuur. We nemen snel beslissingen, geven mensen veel verantwoordelijkheid en zoeken continu naar manieren om beter te worden. We waarderen mensen die kritisch meedenken, elkaar helpen en plannen omzetten in actie.

Een missie die ertoe doet. We bouwen technologie die de energietransitie versnelt. Met jouw werk help je duurzame verwarming voor steeds meer huishoudens bereikbaar te maken.

Klaar om mee te bouwen?

We zoeken iemand die meer wil dan verantwoordelijk zijn voor de cijfers. Iemand die wil meebouwen aan een bedrijf, richting wil geven en blijvende impact wil maken.

Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
description:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

Engineering Manager
description:
The company 

Smart Electric Vehicle Charging Solutions. That’s the business we are in!

GreenFlux offers a cloud-based charge point management SaaS (Software as a Service) solution. This software platform enables Charge Point Operators (CPOs) and e-Mobility Service Providers (eMSPs) to successfully launch their respective businesses. With its offering, GreenFlux plays a pivotal role in facilitating the uptake of electric vehicles and the renewable energy revolution.

Our Development department is responsible for the technical design of new features, owns the architecture, and does technical operation. We are organised in agile end-to-end teams, working with well-defined and transparent processes. Our tech stack is centred around Microsoft .NET on Azure.

To keep up with the rapid market and business expansion and to support the company’s dynamic growth, we are looking to bring an Engineering Manager to the team.

The job 

The Engineering Managers (internally referred to as Heads of Engineering) are responsible for the performance of our development teams and the quality of our platform. You will be responsible for line managing the engineers of up to three development teams, ensuring they have the right direction, skills, and support to deliver high-quality results. Besides this, you will contribute to improving our agile way of working and strengthening engineering practices throughout the Development department.

Key result areas include:

  • Leadership and accountability: You are the hierarchical manager of the engineers in your teams and are accountable for growing those teams to become autonomous and highly performing. You set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and are accountable for individual and team performance. You actively identify and address performance issues and skill gaps, coaching and developing engineers to become more self-sufficient and effective.

  • Delivery and execution: You take responsibility for ensuring your teams deliver high-quality software in a predictable and efficient manner. You proactively manage risks, dependencies, and impediments, taking action when delivery or quality is at risk and driving improvements where needed.

  • Technical quality: You use your technical background to assess and challenge engineering decisions, ensuring that software solutions meet the required standards for quality, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. You work closely with engineers and technical leads to promote sound technical decisions and address technical debt

  • Continuous improvement: You drive improvements in engineering processes, ways of working, and the adoption of modern technologies, practices, and tools. You identify opportunities to increase efficiency, improve delivery performance, and strengthen engineering quality across teams.

  • Team development: You build and maintain high-performing teams by ensuring the right balance of skills, experience, and perspectives. You proactively identify development needs, support professional growth, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  • Quality and documentation: You promote strong engineering standards, effective quality control, and clear technical documentation to support the long-term stability and maintainability of our platform.

  • Strategic contribution: You contribute to setting the strategic direction of the Development department, translating broader objectives into concrete improvements and actions within your teams.


Requirements

We are looking for a strong and accountable engineering leader who combines a people-oriented approach with a clear focus on delivery, technical quality, and results. You empower your teams and create an environment where people take ownership of their work. You have a strong agile mindset without being dogmatic about tools and frameworks, and you know when to coach, challenge, or take decisive action to improve performance.

You have

  • 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager, preferably in a tech scale-up or SaaS environment.

  • A solid background in software engineering, with the technical expertise to evaluate engineering decisions and assess software quality, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

  • Proven experience in leading engineering teams, setting clear expectations, managing performance, and addressing skill gaps through coaching, feedback, and development.

  • A strong focus on delivery and execution, with the ability to take ownership of results, proactively manage risks, and drive improvements.

  • Extensive knowledge of software development processes, modern engineering practices, and agile ways of working.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to challenge decisions, provide constructive feedback, and collaborate with different stakeholder groups.

  • The ability to think and act strategically while also translating plans into concrete actions and measurable improvements.

  • Fluency in English. Dutch is a plus.

  • A drive for continuous learning and self-improvement.

  • A sustainable mindset!

Our offer

Working at GreenFlux means working in a dynamic, innovative, and informal organization, where new ideas and developments move quickly, and each day brings new opportunities and challenges. At one of the most inspiring locations in Amsterdam, you will have the chance to actively contribute to a sustainable future!

We are striving towards an international and inclusive team, so we also offer Visa sponsorship and relocation compensation to expats.

Join our revolution in mobility and energy!

title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results.

description:
Senior Product Manager - Business Banking

Build with us

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We’re one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs, with 900+ Mollies across 12+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you’re solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you’ll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you’re ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

Your impact

As Senior Product Manager, you'll own a significant part of our Business Banking product, one of the newest and most ambitious areas we're building at Mollie.

This is a build from scratch opportunity. Mollie's position here is rare: we're a payment service provider with a large, established customer base that is now building a full banking proposition on top of it. That means you get the ambition and pace of building something new, combined with the resources, customers, and best practices of a scaled business. You'll work alongside experienced, passionate product leaders who've done this before.

You'll lead a cross-functional team across design, product, and data analytics. There are no direct reports in this role, but you'll own the team's day to day performance and make sure things ship on time.

What you'll ship

  • Net-new propositions, not incremental iteration. You're building experiences that don't exist yet.

  • Customer-facing product and APIs across the Mollie app (web and native mobile) for business banking customers.

  • A banking proposition layered on Mollie's existing payments infrastructure, reaching customers who are already active and engaged.

What you'll bring

  • Experience leading a cross-functional product team in an everyday, hands-on capacity

  • Comfort with the full product lifecycle, including early-stage building and scaling

  • Ability to operate in a high-ambition, high-resource environment alongside experienced and passionate product leaders from across the industry

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

In this role, you’ll have the unique opportunity to build a meaningful distribution channel from the ground up. As we expand across Europe, you will grow alongside the product area you own. You’ll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

Snelstart helpt dagelijks ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants slimmer te werken en groeit hard. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
Senior Deal Desk Analyst - Dublin
Agentic AI Principal
AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day.

As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you.

You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together.

You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date.

You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence.

You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law.

You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter.

You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

  • You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years.

  • Strong experience in agentic AI.

  • You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

  • You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses.

  • You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough.

  • You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

  • You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs.

  • You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful.

  • Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

  • A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

  • Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

  • Base salary between €4,477 and €5,793 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

  • A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

  • 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

  • A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

  • A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

  • Collective insurance plans.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

  • Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.

  • Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

We'd love to tell you everything about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within 2 working days. Any questions first? Text or call Nadine at 0628556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.

Your impact

Dutch clinical registries are among the richest sources of outcome data in Europe. At LOGEX, that data reaches clinicians and hospitals through applications such as Codman and Data Entry, and reaches researchers and healthcare professionals through data requests and exports. As Senior Product Owner you own that portfolio end to end: the applications that clinicians use every day, and the data pipelines that power them.

You are the product owner for our largest registry partner and decide what gets built within a fixed capacity. You also make sure that what we build strengthens the wider LOGEX platform wherever possible.

What you'll own

  • Applications: user-facing applications for manual data entry, dashboarding and exports – owning the roadmap, priorities and release quality.

  • Pipelines and business logic: registry processing (merge, load, curation), data exports, scientific data requests, data linkage and registry development sets.

  • One backlog, two types of developers: you lead the product work of a team that combines data engineers with back-end and front-end developers. You translate user and partner’s needs into work for both, and you see early where a front-end change depends on a pipeline change.

  • Prioritisation within fixed capacity: you align with one counterpart at our largest registry partner on what gets built and when, with transparent trade-offs, realistic yearly planning and a clear path to extra capacity when it is funded.

  • Reusable by design: you turn partner-specific needs into shared LOGEX components wherever possible, in close collaboration with other Product Owners and Product Managers.

  • Regulatory and standards readiness: you make sure the products keep meeting healthcare regulation and move along with open data standards, e.g. FHIR.

  • Run and improve: you balance new development with maintenance and technical debt, and you help to reduce key-person risk in a small team.

  • Customer-facing: you work closely with the Customer Office on scope, project proposals and delivery expectations, and you represent the products in partner and user sessions.


What you bring

  • At least 5 years of experience as product owner or product manager

  • Proven experience with healthcare analytics or healthcare data: you understand how clinical, operational or registry data becomes insight

  • Experience working with a team of mixed engineering profiles

  • Experience managing a demanding, influential stakeholder or key client

  • Commercial awareness: you understand the difference between paid and internal work, and what it means for team capacity

  • Knowledge of clinical registries or research data is a strong plus

  • Fluent in Dutch and English, spoken and written

  • Personal and professional development opportunities through our LOGEX Academy

  • Access to our mental health partner, OpenUp

Senior Engineer Product Intelligence (Materials Engineering – Chemistry & Thin Film Design)
International Expansion
description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue.

  • High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of Dutch markets and business models.

  • Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it.

  • Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible.

  • Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements.

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll define the technical direction for Airwallex’s Payments Platform, lead architecture decisions and build highly reliable, high-volume distributed systems that directly affect merchant experience and business outcomes.

You’ll design and build scalable backend services, REST APIs, event-driven systems and integration components within a microservices architecture, connecting with our React frontend. You’ll drive complex initiatives across payment gateways, acquiring, issuing, card networks and local payment methods, while partnering with product, business, infrastructure and external engineering teams to turn merchant needs into technical solutions.

You’ll raise the engineering bar through architectural reviews, thoughtful approaches to technical debt, strong design practices, code quality, testing, observability, reliability and mentorship.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including Staff-level technical leadership or equivalent ownership of complex backend systems.

  • Strong experience designing and operating high-volume distributed systems, preferably in payments, fintech, commerce or financial infrastructure.

  • Recent hands-on experience with Java or Kotlin and Spring or Spring Boot.

  • Expert experience building REST APIs, backend microservices, Kafka-based event streams and distributed data stores such as Cassandra, Hazelcast, Oracle Coherence or similar.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, plus Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Strong familiarity with observability and operational tooling such as New Relic, StatsD, ELK, Datadog, Prometheus or similar.

  • A proven ability to lead projects from concept to production, with a focus on quality, testing, reliability and maintainability.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence across engineering, product and business stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience building payment gateways, acquiring platforms, issuing platforms or payment acceptance infrastructure.

  • Experience integrating major card networks such as Visa and Mastercard.

  • Experience with local payment methods such as iDEAL, Klarna, Trustly or similar.

  • Familiarity with authorisation, capture, refunds, chargebacks, settlement, reconciliation, fraud, risk or PCI/compliance workflows.

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading cross-team technical initiatives.

You'll thrive here if

  • You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it.

  • You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you’re thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

  • You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

Learn more about your team

Payments Platform at Airwallex builds the infrastructure that turns global payment complexity into reliable, scalable payment experiences, helping businesses accept and process money across markets with less friction. The challenge is balancing performance, reliability, local complexity, and commercial outcomes in the same system, where small improvements can materially affect conversion and failures are immediately visible. You'll do well here if you're thoughtful, pragmatic, and motivated by making complex problems feel simple to customers. If you want to build the platform that makes payments work seamlessly for businesses around the world, this is the team at the center of that mission.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

This is a hands-on role reporting directly to the Security Lead, with regular check-ins on priorities.

title: Stage Software Development
description:
Stage Software Development 

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende (afstudeer) stage, waarbij je in aanraking komt met de nieuwste ontwikkelmethodes? Wil je ervaren hoe het is om mee te bouwen aan een platform dat wereldwijd wordt gebruikt door duizenden gebruikers? Dan is een stage bij IXON wellicht iets voor jou!


Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten en machines. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access,  geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld.


Bouw jij mee? 

Verdeeld over verschillende SCRUM-teams is ons R&D-team verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en  ontwikkelen van het IXON Cloud-platform. Elk aspect van onze oplossing, dan de robuuste backend tot de gebruiksvriendelijke frontend, geavanceerde hardware en onze wereldwijde DevOps-infrastructuur, wordt met passie en expertise binnen onze muren ontwikkeld. 


Ons R&D-team, dat inmiddels bestaat uit meer dan 30 technische specialisten, staat altijd open voor jonge talenten die willen groeien en zich verder willen ontwikkelen. Tijdens elke stageperiode bieden we meerdere plekken aan voor studenten in de volgende deelgebieden: 

  • Backend development; 

  • Frontend development; 

  • Embedded Software Development; 

  • DevOps; 

  • Security; 

  • Software testing. 


Hierbij kom je aanraking met onze tech-stack, bestaande uit: 

  • Python; 

  • C++;

  • Rust; 

  • Angular; 

  • Typescript; 

  • Playwright; 

  • Zabbix; 

  • Linux; 

  • MariaDB;

  • Kubernetes; 

  • SALT. 

Uiteraard staan we altijd open voor inbreng van studenten op het gebied van nieuwe tooling, frameworks en technieken. 


Welke opdrachten kan je verwachten?

  • Studio for e-mail

Door de aanhoudende groei van het aantal IXON Cloud-gebruikers neemt de diversiteit aan specifieke wensen toe. Een veelgehoorde behoefte is het personaliseren van e-mailberichten die vanuit het platform naar de eindgebruikers worden verstuurd. Momenteel zijn de aanpassingsmogelijkheden beperkt tot enkel de kleuren en logo's. Het doel van deze opdracht is om klanten volledige controle te bieden over de vormgeving en inhoud van hun e-mails. Om dit te realiseren, wordt een intuïtieve e-mailstudio ontwikkeld waarmee de gebruiker eenvoudig en naar eigen inzicht berichten kan opstellen en beheren.

  • Support Beckhoff ADS via pull application (Embedded Software Development)

Implementeer ondersteuning voor het Beckhoff ADS-protocol in C++ om de compatibiliteit van de IXON data pipeline te vergroten. Je realiseert de volledige koppeling op de gateway en maakt data-logging eenvoudig configureerbaar in de fleet manager.

  • Het versnellen van End-to-End (E2E) testen (Software testing)

Optimaliseer de End-to-End testomgeving van de IXON Cloud om de feedbackcyclus en release-snelheid voor ontwikkelaars te verhogen. Je identificeert knelpunten en implementeert versnellingsoplossingen binnen de GitLab CI/CD-pipeline.

Hier herken jij jezelf in 

Je bent een HBO student in de richting van (Embedded) Software Development, Security of aanverwant en bent op zoek naar een (afstudeer)stage met impact. Je hebt een passie voor het ontwikkelen van toffe softwareoplossingen en krijgt graag de vrijheid om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Daarbij ga je niet voor shortcuts, maar werk je gestructureerd aan kwalitatieve oplossingen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamplayer, die daardoor moeiteloos meedraait in een van onze SCRUM teams. 


Dit hebben wij jou te bieden 

  • Een mooie stagevergoeding;

  • Een relaxte werkomgeving met jonge en ambitieuze developers, met wie je altijd kunt sparren over de nieuwste technologieën;

  • Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen onze organisatie.

title: Senior Implementation Specialist - Dutch Speaking
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Team

The Implementation team onboards our Premium, Pro and Enterprise customers onto the Perk platform, guiding them from signup to launch. We provide consultative, administrative, technical and educational support, and recommend ways to optimise each client's experience.


About the Role

The Senior Implementation Specialist is a change management and consultative expert who owns the onboarding and successful adoption of our Enterprise clients. You dig deep into client needs, define the best onboarding strategy, and lead change inside the customer's organisation. You bridge platform capabilities and client expectations, delivering a 7-star experience from first contact through long-term success.

You ensure new clients are fully prepared to book business travel on Perk: configuring accounts to their requirements, supporting integrations and troubleshooting, and getting users ready through tailored training. You are confident steering clients towards the recommendations that serve them best in the long term, even when these differ from their original request.

Technical expertise is central to the role. You are the in-depth expert on the Perk Travel platform and its configuration options, and you understand integrations and open APIs well enough to guide clients and their IT teams through marketplace partner and custom-built setups. You can troubleshoot issues, translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences, and recommend the most effective mix of automations, integrations and platform features for each client. You also learn new tools and concepts quickly as the product evolves.

You are also a mentor for the Implementation team and the wider Revenue organisation, trusted as a source of expertise both internally and externally.



Responsibilities

  • Be the first impression of Perk and the first point of contact for clients and escalations throughout implementation, always delivering 7-star service.

  • Hold consultative conversations to gather client requirements, and answer them with experience and data-driven best-practice recommendations.

  • Own the timeline, rollout plan and account while it is in implementation, preparing and executing onboarding plans with strong project management and directing work across the internal team.

  • Act as the subject matter expert in change management and adoption, leading customers through introducing a new travel tool and policies, and providing guides, templates and recommendations to support long-term success.

  • Act as a technical solutions expert: identify the best solutions for each client's needs, prioritising automations, integrations and the full range of platform functionality.

  • Configure client accounts to their specifications and provide technical support and troubleshooting, including setting up integrations with marketplace partners or custom-built API solutions.

  • Plan and deliver tailored training sessions for newly onboarded customers, including executive-level stakeholders and company-wide training.

  • Lead cross-functional projects, keeping all internal stakeholders aligned on the goal of full customer ramp-up. Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, Product, Engineering and Finance.

  • Prioritise accounts based on client and business needs.

  • Simplify complex technical information for all audiences.

  • Support Pre-Sales by explaining what an implementation will look like and how the platform can meet prospects' needs.

  • Validate configuration and account satisfaction by monitoring client booking behaviour after launch, and proactively offering support or recommendations.

  • Review completed implementations to improve your own process and the team's, following a cycle of execute, assess, improve, repeat.

  • Mentor colleagues and set an example for the Implementation team and the wider Revenue organisation.


What we look for

  • A customer-first mindset, focused on a smooth onboarding and on what clients need to be happy in the long term.

  • A proven track record as a high achiever in an Implementation Specialist role, with previous experience working with Enterprise clients.

  • Success managing and delivering complex, international projects in a fast-paced environment, including defining scope and handling changing requirements while keeping the project on course.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with C-level stakeholders to clarify their requirements and concerns clearly and professionally.

  • Superb communication skills, and the ability to build relationships at all levels internally and externally, adapting your approach as needed.

  • A thoughtful, consultative approach to making recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Organised, structured and analytical, with strong problem-solving skills, creativity in solutions and keen attention to detail.

  • Tech-savvy, with an understanding of basic technical concepts around integrations and open APIs, and the ability to learn and adapt quickly.

  • A solution-oriented, proactive mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement, spotting opportunities to improve things for clients and the team.

  • Excitement for challenges and a personal drive to make a difference.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.
